description: Main source file for an MQTT publisher sample application using Zephyr RTOS, including network setup, MQTT client configuration, TLS support, and event handling.

methods.name: mqtt_evt_handler
methods.description: Handles MQTT events such as connection, disconnection, acknowledgments, and ping responses.

methods.name: get_mqtt_payload
methods.description: Generates MQTT message payload based on QoS.

methods.name: get_mqtt_topic
methods.description: Returns MQTT topic string based on configuration.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes MQTT message with specified QoS.

methods.name: broker_init
methods.description: Initializes broker address and optional proxy settings.

methods.name: client_init
methods.description: Configures MQTT client parameters, buffers, transport, and TLS if enabled.

methods.name: try_to_connect
methods.description: Attempts to connect to MQTT broker with retries.

methods.name: process_mqtt_and_sleep
methods.description: Processes MQTT input and maintains connection within a timeout.

methods.name: publisher
methods.description: Main loop to connect, publish messages with different QoS, and disconnect.

methods.name: start_app
methods.description: Starts the MQTT publisher application, managing multiple connections if configured.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point initializing TLS, threading, and starting the application.
